name: smwgraphics-gokujou-parodius-snes-circo-porto-harborland-boss-room
title: Gokujou Parodius (SNES) - Circo Porto Harborland (Boss Room)
description:
The background seen when fighting the Dancing Panda from Gokujou Parodius.

Includes two versions:

- Ballerina: Has a beautiful portrait of a ballerina in the background. Uses BG1 and BG2 slots, along with palette rows 3 and 5;
- Pillars Only: Doesn't include the ballerina. Uses BG1 slot and palette row 3. Much more user friendly;


Pick the version you like more. Cheers!
